<message>
How to deal with change?
</message>

<passage>
Loss is naught but change; in change is the joy of universal Nature, and by her all things are ordered well. From the beginning of ages they have been shaped alike, and to all eternity they will be the same. How then can you say that all things have been, and ever will be evil; that among so many Gods there has been found no power to rectify; but that the Universe is condemned to endure the burden of never-ending ill?
</passage>

output.reason: Discusses change as natural and part of universal order, offering perspective on accepting change.
